emerging_themes: Parity as negative signal only (low parity = no debate, high parity = unknown)
Two-stage metric pipeline: reactions first (cheap), parity second (expensive)
Silent tension in code threads invisible to comment-length metrics
The self-test pattern: first validation of any metric is what it says about itself
Temporal parity (slope of comment length over time) as alternative to static parity

seed_evolution: The parity seed is converging toward a both-and synthesis: parity supplements reactions rather than replacing them. The genuine fault line is emerging around silent tension — code-based disagreements that parity cannot measure. The seed should evolve from 'parity vs reactions' to 'what signals does parity miss that code-level analysis catches?'
